engine_note: All runs used engine files byte-identical to 8cffc91: smooth replicates, pure nulls and ridge 0-2 ran in the main tree before the first post-8cffc91 engine edit (22:40:11Z); the HEAD changes up to then were a comment in stats.py. Ridge 3-4, the r3-r4 S1 nulls and all analyses ran in a git worktree pinned at 8cffc91.

notes.a: Failure 3 = variability, not an engine bug. Realised false S1-obs hits 10/4/8/3/9 vs null mean 5.5-6.5 per draw (P(null >= realised) 0.07/0.84/0.23/0.89/0.26; totals 34 vs 29.2). The suite's 0.036 is reproduced exactly by draws 0-19 (mean 4.85/133); B=100 gives 0.042. The test also compares FDR_emp_fixed with |hits_obs| including neutral pairs (~20 per toy) against FDP_true over non-neutral hits; on the same denominator, FDR_emp is 0.050-0.058. False hits: 25/34 noise-driven, 5 lineage/latent structure, 4 proxies of planted determinants (e.g. LOSS arm mates not labelled proxy_ok). Observed and null use the same code path (strata, NA permutation, CR2 df, F1/F2). The oracle shows the same spread (FDP 0.038-0.113).
notes.b: Failure 5: S1-pred 6 hits in 5/20 toys. The oracle gives 3 hits in 2/20, with only 2 pairs shared. For 4/6 engine hits (binary, 23-80 carriers, nu 31-109) the oracle p is 10-100x larger: per-test CR2 t dispersion relative to OLS (1st-99th percentile of |t_engine/t_oracle| 0.24-4.2). Four of the toys have a single rejection at the BH cutoff; the DESIGN 5.3 carrier-df fallback raises their p 1.5-4.5x. Consistent with the far-tail CR2+nu anticonservatism that triggered the fallback; re-check post-fix. P(any non-neutral hit): S1-obs 0.00, S1-pred 0.25, MD-strict 0.30, MD-global 0.00, EN-pred 0.55, EN-obs 0.65, F2 lists 0.00. Some EN hits are an answer-key gap: in null toy 0, LOSS locus-group mates of the self-null gene's neutral LOSS_g.
notes.c: Failure 1 = design property. Without centring, S1-pred BH has 5/4/3/4/4 artefacts (0 centred), EN-pred 0/5 (freq 0.36-0.50), MD-strict 0 either way. With the centred run's lambda held fixed, EN-pred selects 5/5 in every replicate, so the cause is the 1-SE lambda, which is ~3.5x larger on the uncentred target (0.07-0.12 vs 0.02-0.035). CV over random folds instead of cv_fold gives the same lambda (<= 1/5 selected), so the author's 'CV over cv_fold' mechanism is not confirmed. The likelier cause is unexplained fold-offset variance inflating the CV-MSE and its SE. The NC4/fold bound is checked on EN-pred, but its oracle derivation used raw S1-pred BH (live 4.95/5): a list mismatch.
notes.d: MD-global = EN-pred selected ∩ S1-obs F1 BH, same sign. Smooth r0-4: FDP 0 (5/5), recall 0.867-0.883 (= MD-strict). Ridge r0-4: FDP 0/0/0.013/0/0.025 vs MD-strict 0.228/0.255/0.237/0.200/0.160, identical recall 0.865/0.926/0.849/0.815/0.828. Pure null P(any) 0.00. EN-obs selected on ridge: 0/0.136/0.035/0.017/0.162.
notes.e: Failure 4 = design property (double dip), confirmed: ridge r0 MD-strict FDP 0.228 (23/101). Of 106 false hits over 5 ridge toys, 6 are proxies of planted determinants, 43 are in-sample lineage/latent structure and 57 are D-noise associations. |t| is 1.9-3.9 (p_sc 0.001-0.03); they pass the within-selection BH and fail full-family BH.
